label: removes-undocumented-fuel-fields-issuing
content:
# Removes undocumented fuel fields

## What’s new

Removes the following undocumented fuel fields from the [Issuing Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource in favor of the `_decimal` equivalents:

- `purchase_details.fuel.unit_cost`
- `purchase_details.fuel.volume`

## Impact

Removes undocumented attributes of the `Transaction` [object](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20), replacing them with equivalent attributes in the form of `*_decimal`.

## Changes

#### REST API

| Parameters | Change | Resources or endpoints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `purchase_details.fuel.unit_cost`, `purchase_details.fuel.volume` | Removed | [Issuing.Transaction](/api/issuing/transactions/object?api-version=2024-06-20) |
| `unit_cost`, `volume`, `volume_decimal` | Removed | [Issuing.Transaction.purchase_details.fuel](/api/issuing/transactions/object?api-version=2024-06-20#issuing_transaction_object-purchase_details-fuel) |

3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
